works.name: Mac
works.text: Intel processor, macOS 13 or newer. An early version: not notarized by Apple, tested on macOS 15.

works.name: Android
works.text: The same app on a phone: the same dashboard, sites and files. Android 15 or newer. A beta: download it from this site on the phone.

planned.name: One series never stops the rest
planned.text: A series the site answers oddly for is set aside, shown with the reason and tried again later, while everything else carries on.

planned.name: Creator's notes, music, views and comments
planned.text: Saved beside each episode when you choose them; every one starts off. Comments are from Tapas.

planned.name: Sign in with Google or Facebook
planned.text: Today you set a password on your account first.

planned.name: A notice when a download needs you
planned.text: A desktop notification when a download stops and waits.

planned.name: Moving a library
planned.text: "Move library here", and finding a library folder that was renamed.

planned.name: Choosing single series
planned.text: Save only the series you pick.

planned.name: Reading the saved extras
planned.text: Creator's notes, music and comments shown beside the episode, in the app and when it is exported.
